eos_paired_change_check.comparison: total_with_eos contrast minus answer_sum contrast for the same query, task and label
eos_paired_change_check.jq_filter: [.per_query[] as $q | $q.tasks | to_entries[] as $t | $t.value.contrasts | to_entries[] as $c | $c.value as $v | $v | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("answer_sum/margin/")) | (.key | ltrimstr("answer_sum/")) as $metric | {query_id:$q.query_id, task:$t.key, contrast:$c.key, metric:$metric, delta:($v["total_with_eos/" + $metric] - .value), bound:(if $c.key=="LxD" then 0.00537109375 else 0.002685546875 end)} | .absolute_difference=(.delta|fabs)] | {paired_readouts:length, maximum:max_by(.absolute_difference), above_numerical_band:(map(select(.absolute_difference>.bound))|length), task_maxima:(group_by(.task)|map({task:.[0].task,maximum:max_by(.absolute_difference)}))}
eos_paired_change_check.interpretation: Descriptive sensitivity of registered paired readouts; not a new acceptance gate, bootstrap endpoint or additive EOS-only group margin.

scope: Completed Qwen3-8B full-dev numerical measurement only; no test, other model or internal intervention was started.
